name: Laravel MCP Chat (Tech Day) - PHP 8.3 (no Features)
postCreateCommand: set -euxo pipefail && sudo apt-get update -y && sudo apt-get install -y sqlite3 libsqlite3-dev build-essential autoconf pkg-config && sudo bash -lc 'export PHP_INI_DIR=/usr/local/etc/php; docker-php-source extract; docker-php-ext-install -j"$(nproc)" sockets; mkdir -p "$PHP_INI_DIR/conf.d"; echo "extension=sockets" > "$PHP_INI_DIR/conf.d/docker-php-ext-sockets.ini"; docker-php-source delete' && if [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi && sed -i "s/^DB_CONNECTION=.*/DB_CONNECTION=sqlite/" .env && sed -i "s|^DB_DATABASE=.*|DB_DATABASE=${PWD}/database/database.sqlite|" .env && mkdir -p database && php -r "file_exists('database/database.sqlite') || touch('database/database.sqlite');" && XDEBUG_MODE=off php artisan key:generate --ansi && XDEBUG_MODE=off php artisan migrate --graceful --ansi || true && XDEBUG_MODE=off php artisan storage:link || true && composer install && bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR=/usr/local/share/nvm; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] || (mkdir -p "$NVM_DIR" && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.39.7/install.sh | bash); . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm install --lts && nvm use --lts && (command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && (npm ci || npm install))' && sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d && sudo cp .devcontainer/php/xdebug.ini /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/99-xdebug.ini && php -m | grep -i sockets && php -v
